messages.development_action: Raise province development — industry projects, occupation stability, and infrastructure investment increase build capacity.
messages.development_investment_hint: Development gates advanced lines: factories and infrastructure raise local dev over time; dedicated investment projects are planned.
messages.development_gap_action: Need development %d (have %d, +%d) — prioritize industry and infrastructure here, or move the line to a higher-dev province.
messages.terrain_sea_land: Land production is not possible in open sea provinces
messages.terrain_port_required: Naval production requires a coastal province with port access
messages.terrain_dev_bonus: %s terrain raises the development bar for %s by +%d (need %d, have %d)
messages.retool_vs_reloc_tech: Research lock — finish required tech before retooling; changing province won't help.
messages.retool_vs_reloc_dev: Development lock — relocate line to %s (Production → new design, retooling downtime) or invest in dev here.
messages.retool_vs_reloc_terrain: Geography lock — move production to %s; retooling cannot fix terrain or missing port.
messages.retool_vs_reloc_factory: Factory mismatch — retool plant type, pick a design this factory supports, or move line to a province with the right plant.
messages.retool_in_place: Same province: assign a new design in Production; retooling cost and recovery still apply.
messages.relocate_priority: Strategic: relocating blocked lines often beats waiting for development in unsuitable provinces.
messages.dev_growth_factories: Active factories in the province gradually increase development while lines run.
messages.dev_growth_infra: Higher infrastructure (build/repair) improves local industry and unlocks faster recovery.
messages.decision_relocate_now: ↗ Move blocked lines to %s — faster than raising dev here.
messages.decision_invest_here: 📈 Invest here (+{gap} dev to reach {need}) — worth it if you want a long-term hub.
messages.decision_retool_here: ↻ Retool in place — change design or factory type on the Production screen.
messages.decision_research_first: 🔬 Research first — relocation and retooling won't bypass missing tech.
messages.production_assign_action: Production: assign this design at {target} (retooling applies)
messages.production_invest_action: Production: keep lines here · repair infra · add factories to raise dev
messages.retool_if: ↻ Retool here if: keeping a long-term industrial hub, same factory type works, or dev gap is only +1 with {factories} factories already.
messages.relocate_if: ↗ Relocate to {target} if: terrain/port blocks you, dev gap ≥2, or you need output before local dev catches up.
messages.development_growth_short: Grow dev: {factories} factories + infra {infra} → dev {next} unlocks {unlock}
messages.development_unlocks_production: Higher development unlocks factory types and era lines — invest here or ↗ relocate for output now.
messages.picker_strong_domain: Filtered {domain}: strong province for this domain
messages.picker_weak_domain: Filtered {domain}: weak here — use ↗ rows or another province
messages.profile_weak_hint: Weak domains need higher dev, ports, or different terrain — invest or ↗ relocate.
messages.decision_relocate_no_target: ↗ Relocate blocked lines — open Production at a stronger province
messages.picker_empty_relocate: Nothing buildable here — try ↗ {target} or raise development
messages.invest_panel_invest: ↻ INVEST HERE: keep {factories} factories running + repair infra (+{gap} dev to reach {need}) — next tier unlocks {unlock}
messages.invest_panel_reloc: ↗ RELOCATE to {target}: assign in Production for output now
messages.invest_panel_or_reloc: ↗ OR relocate to {target} if you need output before local dev catches up
messages.development_picker_hint: Dev {cur}: {factories} factories + infra {infra} raise industry here · dev {next} unlocks {unlock}

messages.invest_reloc_headline_reloc: Move production to {target} for output now
messages.invest_reloc_headline_invest: Invest in this province as your industrial hub
messages.invest_reloc_headline_split: Split strategy: output now vs hub here
messages.invest_detail_short: — long-term hub: higher dev unlocks more factory types
messages.reloc_detail_terrain: — terrain or port blocks builds here
